target: and it passes when the string genuinely is not there
cmd:
mkdir -p c/syn
cat > c/syn/s.json <<'CASEEOF'
{"id": "syn-4", "kind": "bash-unit", "target": "synthetic", "checks": [{"type": "must_not_find", "strings": ["FORBIDDEN"]}], "cmd": "echo all clear"}
CASEEOF
EVAL_CASES_DIR="$PWD/c" "$PLUGIN_ROOT/evals/run_eval.sh" --suite syn > run.out 2>&1; printf '{"code":%s}' $?
_note: Also asserts the runner did not merely SKIP must_not_find as an unknown type — without that, this case passed before the feature existed, which is the same vacuous-pass shape it is meant to test.
